name: Win/Loss Analysis Agent
headline: Turn closed-deal evidence into a strategy review
summary: Help sales operations, enablement, and leadership compare win and loss patterns, isolate addressable drivers, draft counter-strategies, and evaluate clearly labeled scenarios.
capabilities: Aggregate and analyze historical deal data for trend identification
Synthesize buyer feedback and competitor patterns into actionable insights
Develop targeted counter-strategies and enablement playbooks for reps
Model revenue recovery scenarios for leadership decision-making
value: Creates a consistent view of trends, competitors, and loss drivers.
Connects buyer-feedback themes to draft enablement responses.
Supports leadership scenario review without claiming realized performance.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Compare win and loss patterns
scenarios.prompt: Compare the bundled synthetic Q3 and Q2 win and loss patterns and show where the decline is concentrated.

scenarios.title: Find the root causes
scenarios.prompt: Identify the evidence-backed synthetic loss drivers and buyer feedback themes that enablement should review.

scenarios.title: Draft counter-strategies
scenarios.prompt: Draft counter-strategy and talk-track options from the synthetic loss evidence for enablement review.

scenarios.title: Model value scenarios
scenarios.prompt: Model synthetic intervention scenarios without presenting them as realized or committed revenue.

scenarios.title: Draft the board narrative
scenarios.prompt: Draft a board-level synthetic win and loss narrative with all investment and performance values labeled as scenarios.

scenarios.title: Summarize next steps
scenarios.prompt: Summarize the synthetic findings and candidate next steps without activating programs or approvals.
